items.prompt: Two fair dice are coupled to always show the same face. What remains true about the expectation of their SUM?

options.text: It becomes 7/2 because there is only one random face.
options.why: There is one random face but the sum doubles it; the sum expectation is 7.

options.text: It becomes 12 because the dice agree.
options.why: Agreement changes dependence, not the fair marginal expectation or guaranteed outcome.

options.text: It is 7 by linearity, even without independence.
options.why: Each marginal expectation is 7/2; linearity adds them regardless of dependence.

options.text: It is undefined until independence is supplied.
options.why: Finite expectations add without an independence assumption.

items.explanation: Each marginal expectation is 7/2; linearity adds them regardless of dependence.
